fusions.name: Stinging Cells
fusions.desc: Stinging cells burst around you, dealing 11 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on anything they hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Moray Reach
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health: a lunge that deals 16 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagging Reef
fusions.desc: Plants a snag of reef that stands for 15 seconds and strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds, each strike with a 30% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Brushed Polyp
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles for 6 damage and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
